text: For my 2-way Lancelot speaker, I compared a 2nd order filter with a 1st order + Zobel for the Altec 414. Both yielded nearly the same freq. response. However, whereas with the 2nd order crossover the sound signature of the capacitor was clearly audible, with the Zobel setup that effect was not directly noticeable which surprised me.
